summary: Comprehensive testing of RACCOON APP - Premium live video social matching platform. All core flows tested successfully: Landing page, Guest flow, Age verification, Dashboard, Private Room, and Match page. Mobile responsiveness verified on 390x844 viewport. Backend APIs working correctly (11/13 tests passing).

minor.issue: Signup test fails because terms_agreed is required but test didn't include it
minor.note: This is a test issue, not a bug - the API correctly validates terms agreement

minor.issue: CORS error for country detection API - external service issue
minor.note: Does not affect core functionality, country detection is optional

critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js: Excellent implementation with proper data-testid='landing-start-button', responsive design, and space background
Guest.js: Gender selection and Start Matching flow work correctly with data-testid='start-matching-btn'
Dashboard.js: Both 'Start Matching' and 'Private Room' buttons visible and functional with proper data-testid attributes
PrivateRoom.js: Free users see Join form, Create Room shows premium lock with toast notification
Match.js: Searching state shows 'Finding a Match' with raccoon animation and facts
useMatching.js: Skip with retry logic implemented correctly (MAX_SKIP_RETRIES = 2)
useWebRTC.js: Camera cleanup improved with proper stream management
SocketContext.js: Socket connection with authentication and reconnection handling
match.css: Game mode styles with space background and mini video panels

test_credentials.note: Guest mode works without credentials. No test credentials file found at /app/memory/test_credentials.md

seed_data_creation: None needed - guest flow creates users dynamically
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified working: Landing -> Guest -> Age Verification -> Dashboard -> Match/Private Room. Mobile responsiveness excellent. Socket connection establishes successfully. Games (UNO, Feud, Draw) require two matched premium users to test multiplayer - cannot be tested with single user. Stripe payments are MOCKED.
